name: Cordoban lantern
_about: A CORDOBAN LANTERN (al-Hakam II's maqsura and the Villaviciosa bay, 961-965): a skylit dome raised over one bay of the hall -- walls `W` by `L` (`t` thick) standing on the arcades round the bay to `h` over them, two lobed windows in every face; a deck closing the square's corners to the octagon; the ribbed dome of radius `R` on it. Placed on the arcades' top, centred on the bay.

walls._about: the lantern's walls, standing on the arcades round the bay: two lobed windows in every face, the light falling on the mosaics

deck._about: the square's corners closed up to the dome's octagon (Cordoba's squinches, as a deck)

dome._about: the ribbed dome: eight ribs crossing in an eight-pointed star, a little scalloped cupola in the middle (the finish draws them)
